verdict.rationale: Bench's only documented built-in AI assistant is the AI Categorization Assistant. A user describes a transaction's purpose and it suggests the category in real time, and pattern-based categorization rules are generated automatically. That is one narrow categorization task, not a general assistant users can hand tasks to; other work goes to the human bookkeeping team. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant that can take on tasks beyond categorization (e.g. reporting, reconciliation, tax or document work), documentation of what the assistant can do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
